slot_note: architecture 1 spent: both portal responses landed the call, and its decisive step was the domain's own reflex plus an estimator with seven defensible constructions (stumping 1.1j). Architecture 2 keeps the county and its records and changes the decision, from which scores the tier releases to what the tier costs the jail in beds.
niche: a county jail's forward bed-day bill for the pretrial releases it already makes: how many detention bed-days the defendants released on a written promise at first appearance will cost the jail next year through the custody that follows a failure to appear, when that custody arrives under a new booking number on a new case on charges the release policy's own eligibility list excludes
analyst_test: The analyst takes the defendants released at first appearance, counts the bed-days of their own stays before release, projects that forward and files a figure near a quarter of the true one, because the custody a release actually costs is the booking that follows a failure to appear and 85 per cent of those bed-days sit on charges the release policy's own eligibility list excludes, so every filter the policy's words invite removes them.
domain_test: Corrections capacity planning prices a pretrial release rule in detention bed-days net of the custody the released population generates downstream, which is the field's own bed-day accounting against a rated capacity and a contract bed rate; swap megawatt-hours for bed-days and substations for defendants and nothing answers to a failure to appear producing a fresh arrest on an unrelated charge under a new case number, so the chain that carries the cost has no analogue and the task stops making sense.
layer1: a court case management system replaced on 4 March 2024, so first appearances come in two exports with different layouts, case-number formats and magistrate keys
jail booking and release times in UTC beside court times in Eastern local time

custody spread across booking rows: a move to the Mill Street annex closes one row and opens another at the same minute, and a board-out to a contract facility closes a row while the defendant stays in the Sheriff's custody
a contract facility's bills priced per day or part of a day against the detention centre's midnight counts
offence codes recoded at the system change, joined through the clerk's crosswalk, with the policy appendix listed by general statute number the charge rows do not carry
a state arrest extract matched by state identification number with warrant arrests mixed in with new-offence arrests
dispositions in a separate export, some cases still open at the extract
documents that have to be read (the current bail policy, the draft revision, the extract notes, the jail and court code lists)
stakeholder_role: the budget analyst in the county manager's office, who has to price the draft release tier against the jail's rated beds and the contract bed bill

spine.entity: one booking row of one custody episode at the detention centre or a contract facility
spine.source: constructed (the Sheriff's jail management system export)

world.geography: United States: North Carolina (a fictional county, Dorrance County, and its judicial district; the court structure is North Carolina's, the people, systems and data are fictional)
world.org_type: county manager's office, the Sheriff's detention centre and a neighbouring county's contract facility

driver: The decisive quantity is a net figure whose offsetting term is provisioned in records filed under a different key, a different case and a category the decision's own eligibility rule excludes, so a pipeline that prices the decision on each unit's own record files a figure several times too large and inverts which levels are the cheapest to act on.
driver_concrete: A defendant released on a written promise at a first appearance occupies almost no detention bed-days of their own, and the bed-days the release costs are the custody of the booking that follows a failure to appear, which arrives under a new booking number on a new case on a charge the policy's eligibility list excludes, so the cost is reached only by chaining person and date across that exclusion and is three times the releases' own stays.
stump: The analyst prices next year's releases at the bed-days of the released defendants' own short stays, projects that forward and files a figure about a quarter of the golden, because the custody that follows a failure to appear sits under new booking numbers on charges the eligibility list excludes and runs about 6 bed-days per failure at the lowest assessment score rising to about 19 at the highest.

differentiation.task141: Architecture 1's decisive step was a counterfactual: the outcome rate a level would show if everyone at it were released, recovered from how outcomes rise with each magistrate's own release share, for defendants whose outcomes are unobserved because a magistrate held them. Architecture 2 has no counterfactual anywhere on its path: every quantity is realised custody for defendants who were released, and the difficulty is that the offsetting custody is filed under another key in a category the eligibility rule excludes. One needs an estimator for the unobserved, the other a join for the unjoined.
differentiation.task137: Shares G5. task137 provisions a healthcare quantity elsewhere in the same entity's own record stream over a horizon, so the provision is found by widening the window. Here the provision is in a different entity record (a new booking, a new case, an excluded charge class) with no key to it, so widening the window finds nothing and the chain has to be built from person and date.
differentiation.task270: Shares the county-records surface only. task270's decisive step is a stock-and-flow balance over a censored series; architecture 2 has no censoring on its path (no following stay is open at the extract) and no balance identity, and its figure is a net footprint, not a stock.
differentiation.task98: Shares the gap and the grain mechanism. task98's decisive move removes members from one population using two dated schedules held under different keys, so both schedules are reachable and the difficulty is composing them. Here the costly records are reachable by no key at all (a new booking number, a new case, an excluded charge class) and are found only by chaining person and date, and the quantity is an added cost rather than a removal.
differentiation.task142: Shares the gap, G2 and the forecasting mechanism. task142 builds an upper percentile from the units that generate a total and how long each runs, and its decisive move is that the duration construction cannot be replaced by treating counted rows as independent draws; every unit it needs is reachable and in the file. Here the units that carry the decisive term are reachable by no key, and the move is a chain built from person and date across a category the decision's own eligibility rule excludes, not a duration distribution.
differentiation.task148: Shares the gap and the forecasting mechanism. task148 turns on censoring: patience is observed in full only for the units that gave up, and the served units show a lower bound, so the drain has to be estimated from partial observation. Architecture 2 has no censoring anywhere on its path (measured: no following stay is open at the extract in either frame) and estimates nothing; every bed-day it counts is realised and complete, and the difficulty is reaching the records rather than modelling what the records cut off.
differentiation.task173: Shares the gap and G2. task173's decisive move is that a rate read per unit-year dilutes work-induced failures, so the forward window's failures have to be built from the work schedule rather than carried on a pooled rate; it is a rate-versus-exposure argument. Architecture 2 carries no rate per exposure and no induced hazard: the figure is a census of realised custody, and what defeats the easy route is that the larger half of that census sits under booking numbers and charge classes no filter on the policy's own eligibility list reaches.

lineage.fate: spent, FAILED_TO_STUMP on the portal: both responses landed the call
lineage.driver: Outcomes are recorded only for the units a decision-maker let through, and the decision-makers, who sit by rota and so meet like caseloads, let through very different shares; a rule that lets every unit at a level through has to be priced at the rate the whole level would show, read from how outcomes per unit rise with each decision-maker's let-through share out to all let through, while any rate, model or reweighting fitted on the units already let through keeps the decision-makers' own selection and understates it.

notes: Re-root in the same objective and number, the world and its records kept and the decision changed. overuse.objective on forecasting is answered in the design note: the lane owes forecasting builds and this slot's objective is fixed by the re-root rule. Frame is the four closed years FY22 to FY25, measured as the only gradeable one: per score FY25 alone runs 18 to 24 per cent relative standard error with score 3 above score 4 and 16 per cent of bootstrap draws monotone, against 10 to 13 per cent and 99.6 per cent monotone over four years. Pattern is none and the decisive mechanism is named by G-code: pattern D (two flawless grains) is spent in fourteen earlier builds on this gap and decision type, so the pattern axis is redrawn rather than differentiated fourteen times. G5 is banned against a recent build, so the decisive mechanism is filed as G2 (the decision's unit is a release and all custody it causes, the file's row is one booking) with G8 (the larger half of the cost is reachable by no key) and G11 (the eligibility list excludes the charge classes the cost lands on). Task type is intervention-policing-policy-evaluation: projecting a bail policy's jail-population effect is that task type's forward product. The grain_or_unit strategy-risk WARN is answered by the analyst test, which fails with every field and rule read correctly. Task type is recidivism-risk-assessment, the only criminology-justice task type the guard scores as serving forecasting, and it is the truthful one: the deciding quantity is the custody consequence of re-arrest graded by the assessment score, which is a recidivism-risk product stated in bed-days rather than in a rate. Differentiated against architecture 1 on the decisive step (a counterfactual for the unobserved against a join for the unjoined) and on every other axis (decision type, shape, answer unit, scoring unit, stakeholder, forcing event, context artifact, generators, strategy, layer2 family). The call is about the already-released population, not about defendants a magistrate held: pricing a wider tier would need the held defendants' unobserved failure rate, which is architecture 1's counterfactual and the reason it was spent. Measured: every following stay is closed at the extract in both frames, so the whole path is realised custody.
